question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH clean_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(year, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(year, INSTR(year, ' ') + 1)
            ELSE year
        END as start_year
    FROM Movie
),
clean_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN INSTR(year, ' ') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(year, INSTR(year, ' ') + 1)
            ELSE year
        END as year
    FROM Movie
),
period_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.start_year,
        COUNT(*) as film_count
    FROM clean_years c
    CROSS JOIN clean_movies m
    WHERE CAST(c.start_year AS INTEGER) <= CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) 
      AND CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) <= CAST(c.start_year AS INTEGER) + 9
    GROUP BY c.start_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM period_counts
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 10
